title: Rust JSON to Typed AST and complete Aff compilation

corpus.origin: gopurs-aff 238-module TAST corpus frozen 2026-09-21; selected 12 modules spanning arrays, ADTs, collections, Aff and tests

c_reference.scope: fresh simdjson parsing, ordinary owned C++ strings/vectors/tree nodes and shared type nodes; eager whole-table resolution and lexical source-usage validation; all twelve fingerprints validated exactly; final result destruction separately reported

fixture12.validation: passed: every JSON and TAST fingerprint matches the frozen oracle

gopurs238.validation: passed: every JSON and TAST fingerprint matches the frozen oracle

combined.fingerprinting_excluded: validation before readiness and after the loop; kernel has none

sample.self_time_note: leaf samples from `sample` (>=5), idle worker threads separated

decode.fingerprinting_excluded: validation before readiness and after the loop; kernel has none

sample.self_time_note: leaf samples from `sample` (>=5), idle worker threads separated

gopurs238.benchmark: Purust TAST optimization: complete frozen gopurs-aff backend

protocol.metric: Purust backend total, monotonic rounded milliseconds
protocol.order: sequential; rotate first variant each measured round
protocol.cache: fresh generated output and no .purmeta/.cache per run; OS cache not flushed
protocol.settings: prebuilt binaries; compiler/GC overrides removed, then explicit per-variant env applied
protocol.phase_note: Medians of individual phases are not additive.

validation.comparison: Every Rust source and Cargo manifest equals the previously qualified original-corpus reference byte for byte.

protocol.environment: PURUST_/GOPURS_/NODE_/RUST*/CARGO* removed, then per-variant env applied
